items.item_text: What is the Adoption Date of the document?
items.answer: Effective July 1, 2011; Executed February 6, 2012.
items.citation_note: (Statement Of Purpose / Signature; pdf p6; printed p1)

references.excerpt: Continued Effective As Of July 1, 2011.

items.item_text: What is the Plan Anniversary?
items.answer: July 1 Anniversary Date And Plan Year.

references.excerpt: Anniversary Date: The First Day Of Each July 1.

items.item_text: What are the groups of employees covered under the plan?
items.answer: Employees Of The Company Subject To FICA, Excluding Leased Employees, Faculty, Administrative Salaried Staff, Self-Employed Individuals, Temporary Employees, And Students.

references.excerpt: Eligible Employee... Excluding Persons Who Are Leased Employees, Faculty, Administrative Staff, Self-Employed Individuals, Temporary Employees And Students.

items.item_text: What are the participation eligibility requirements in the plan?
items.answer: Age 21 And 1 Year Of Service; Participation Restricted For Collectively Bargained Employees Unless Agreement Extends Coverage.

references.excerpt: Each Eligible Employee Shall Become An Active Participant... Upon Completion Of One Year Of Service And Attainment Of Age 21.

items.item_text: What is the participation date after attainment of eligibility in the plan?
items.answer: First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following Satisfaction Of Eligibility Requirements.

references.excerpt: Active Participation... Commences As Of The First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following The Date He Satisfies The Eligibility Requirements.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Age 65.

references.excerpt: Normal Retirement Date - The Date On Which A Participant Attains Age 65.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Computed And Payable As Of The First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Retirement Income Shall Be Computed And Payable As Of The First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following His Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Unreduced benefit retirement in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Reduced benefit retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Age 55 And 10 Years Of Service.

references.excerpt: Early Retirement Date - First Day... Following The Date On Which A Participant Attains Age 55, Provided He Has Completed 10 Years Of Service.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: First Day Of Any Month Coincident With Or Following Age 55 And 10 Years Of Service.

references.excerpt: Early Retirement Date - The First Day Of Any Month Coincident With Or Following The Date...

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Age 65; Vested Participant Receives Vested Interest At Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Upon Termination... A Vested Participant, At His Normal Retirement Date, Shall Be Entitled To Receive His Vested Interest.

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Deferred Vested Benefit May Commence Under §8.3; Early Commencement Generally Available At Age 55 With 10 Years Of Service.

references.excerpt: Such Benefit May Commence In Accordance With Section 8.3.

items.item_text: What is the retirement eligibility for late retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Deferred Retirement Date Is The First Day Of Any Month After Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Deferred Retirement Date - The First Day Of Any Month Subsequent To The Participant's Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: What is the eligibility requirement for disability under the plan?
items.answer: Disability Requires Permanent Condition Preventing Substantial Gainful Activity, Social Security Disability Eligibility, Occurring Before Normal Retirement Date, And 10 Years Of Service For Disability Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Disability... Eligible To Receive Benefits Under The Disability Insurance Provisions Of The Social Security Act.

items.item_text: How the plan defines Eligibility/Participation service?
items.answer: Eligibility Service Uses Hours Of Employment; First Computation Period Is 12 Months From First Hour, Then Plan Years.

references.excerpt: For Purposes Of Hours Of Employment For Eligibility... First Applicable Computation Period Shall Be The 12-Consecutive Month Period Beginning As Of The Date A Person First Completed An Hour Of Employment.

items.item_text: How the plan defines vesting service?
items.answer: Vesting Service Uses 12-Consecutive-Month Computation Period Beginning The First Day Of The Month In Which The Person First Completed An Hour Of Employment And Each Anniversary.

references.excerpt: For Purposes Of Determining Service For Vesting And Benefits... 12-Consecutive Month Period Beginning As Of The First Day Of The Month.

items.item_text: How the plan defines benefit service?
items.answer: Credited Service Is Based On Service For Benefits, With Credited Service Limited By The Plan's Service Definition And Break-In-Service Rules.

references.excerpt: Service... Year Of Service, Hour Of Employment, Credited Service.

items.item_text: Does the plan defines other type of service besides eligibility/participation, vesting and benefit service?
items.answer: Break-In-Service, Month Of Service, Year Of Service, Hour Of Employment, Credited Service, Severance From Employment, And Qualified Military Service Are Defined.

references.excerpt: Service (Break-In-Service, Month Of Service, Year Of Service, Hour Of Employment, Credited Service).

items.item_text: What is the accrued benefit formula under the plan?
items.answer: Annual Benefit Is 1.25% Of Average Compensation Times Years Of Credited Service, Payable Monthly As 1/12; Applies To Facilities Union, Non-Union Hourly, And Security Union Participants Active On Or After July 1, 2005.

references.excerpt: 1.25%... Average Compensation, Multiplied By Years Of Credited Service.

items.item_text: What is the Accrual factor in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: 1.25% Of Average Compensation Per Year Of Credited Service.

references.excerpt: 1.25%... Average Compensation, Multiplied By Years Of Credited Service.

items.item_text: What is the Short service factor in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What compensation is used in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Box 1 Form W-2 Wages Plus Certain Salary Reduction Amounts, Excluding Noncompany Pay, Ineligible-Status Pay, Welfare And Fringe Benefits, Reimbursements, Moving Expenses, And Pre-Participation Pay.

references.excerpt: Compensation... Participant's Wages For The Plan Year Paid By The Employer Of The Type Reported In Box 1 Of Form W-2.

items.item_text: How the plan defines average compensation to use in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Compensation During Last 60 Consecutive Calendar Months Of Service, Or Actual Months If Less Than 60, Divided By 5.

references.excerpt: Average Compensation... During The Last 60 Consecutive Calendar Months Of Service... Divided By Five.

items.item_text: What is the Covered Compensation for Integrated Plans?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Primary Insurance Amount (PIA) Offset in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Initial Account Balance in the plan?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Benefit Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Timing of Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Annuity Conversion Factor in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Annuity Conversion Method in the Cash Balance Account?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the eligibility for those?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the amount?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the Duration?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What is the Normal Single Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Normal Form Is Life With 36 Monthly Payments Certain.

references.excerpt: Pension Payable For Life... But If Death Before Receiving 36 Monthly Payments, Pension Continues To Beneficiary Until Balance Of 36 Monthly Payments Has Been Paid.

items.item_text: What is the Normal Married Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Automatic Spouse Benefit Is A Qualified Joint And Survivor Annuity For Married Participants Unless Waived With Spousal Consent.

references.excerpt: Automatic Spouse Benefit.

items.item_text: What is the Basis for Form Conversion Factors as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Lump Sums Use Applicable Interest Rate And Applicable Mortality Rate; Non-Lump-Sum Optional Forms Use 8% Interest And UP84 With 2-Year Age Setback.

references.excerpt: For Purposes Of Determining... Optional Form... Other Than Lump Sum... 8%, Compounded Annually And 2-Year Age Setback Mortality Rates In Accordance With UP84.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Early Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: For Non-Disability Early Commencement, Accrued Benefit Is Reduced 5/9 Of 1% For Each First 60 Months And 5/18 Of 1% For Each Next 60 Months Before Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Reduced By 5/9 Of 1% For Each Of The First 60 Months And 5/18 Of 1% For Each Of The Next 60 Months.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Late Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: Deferred/Late Commencement After Normal Retirement Date Is Actuarially Increased Using 8% Interest And UP84 With 2-Year Age Setback; Deferred Retirement Benefit Is Greater Of Formula At Actual Retirement Or Actuarial Equivalent At Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: If Any Benefit... After Normal Retirement Date Is Payable At A Later Date, It Shall Be Actuarially Increased.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Suspension of Benefit Provisions?
items.answer: Benefits May Be Suspended Under §5.5 For Certain Reemployment After Commencement, Subject To Notice And ERISA Rules.

references.excerpt: Suspension Of Benefits.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Disability Benefit Provisions?
items.answer: Disability Retirement Benefit Equals Actuarial Equivalent Of Accrued Benefit As Of Disability Retirement Date, With Disability Early Commencement Actuarially Reduced.

references.excerpt: Upon Retirement At His Early Or Disability Retirement Date, A Participant Shall Be Entitled To Receive The Actuarial Equivalent Of His Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Pre-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: Before Income Commencement, Death Benefit Is Payable Under §7.1; Earliest Commencement Date Depends On Early Retirement Eligibility Or First Date Participant Would Have Been Eligible.

references.excerpt: Before Income Commencement.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Post-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: After Income Commencement, Death Benefits Are Payable Under The Form In Effect Under §7.2.

references.excerpt: Subsequent To Income Commencement.

items.item_text: What is the Vesting Schedule included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?

references.excerpt: Upon Other Termination Of Employment.

items.item_text: What is the Cash-out Provisions included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: If Present Value Does Not Exceed $1,000, Immediate Distribution Without Consent; Higher Amounts Subject To Plan Consent And Distribution Rules.

references.excerpt: Method And Form Of Payment Of Benefits.

items.item_text: What is the One-Year Break In Service included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: Break-In-Service Means A 12-Consecutive-Month Period With Fewer Than 500 Hours Of Employment, With Special Maternity/Paternity And Family Medical Leave Rules.

references.excerpt: Break-In-Service - A Period Of 12 Consecutive Months During Which An Employee Fails To Accrue 500 Hours Of Employment.

items.item_text: What are the Transfer Provisions defined in the plan?
items.answer: Merger Or Transfer Must Preserve Each Participant's Benefit At Least Equal To The Benefit Immediately Before The Transaction If The Plan Terminated Then.

references.excerpt: Merger Of Plans.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Contributions?
items.answer: No Participant Contributions Are Required.

references.excerpt: No Contributions Shall Be Required Of The Participants.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Interest?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), What provisions are in place  If EEC Withdrawn?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: What are the Voluntary Provisions defined in the plan, if any?
items.answer: N/A

items.item_text: Was the plan Top-Heavy?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Rules Apply Under Article 12 If The Plan Is Top-Heavy For A Plan Year.

references.excerpt: Top-Heavy Provisions.

items.item_text: Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit applies to key employees in addition to non-key employees?
items.answer: No; Top-Heavy Minimum Accrued Benefit Applies To Participants Other Than Key Employees.

references.excerpt: Minimum Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Service?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Service Is Service Credited Under The Plan For Minimum Benefit Purposes During Top-Heavy Years, Subject To Article 12.

references.excerpt: Minimum Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Average Compensation?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Average Compensation Uses Average Compensation As Defined For Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Under Article 12.

references.excerpt: Minimum Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Formula?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Is A Minimum Accrued Benefit Under Article 12 For Non-Key Employees In Top-Heavy Years.

references.excerpt: Minimum Accrued Benefit.

items.item_text: How plan defines Top-Heavy Vesting?
items.answer: Top-Heavy Vesting Applies Under §12.4 If The Plan Is Top-Heavy.

references.excerpt: Minimum Vesting.

items.item_text: How plan defines Default Actuarial Equivalence?
items.answer: Default Actuarial Equivalence Uses §417(e) Applicable Interest And Mortality For Lump Sums; For Non-Lump-Sum Optional Forms, 8% Interest And UP84 With 2-Year Age Setback.

references.excerpt: Actuarial Equivalent.

items.item_text: How plan defines Consensual Lump Sum Provisions?
items.answer: Lump Sum Distributions Are Available Subject To Applicable Interest, Applicable Mortality, And Consent/Payment Rules.

references.excerpt: For Purposes Of Determining The Lump Sum Value Of Any Benefit Payable, The Applicable Interest Rate And The Applicable Mortality Rate Shall Be Used.

items.item_text: Are there any Additional Provisions of Note?
items.answer: Code §436 Benefit Restrictions Are Not Included In This Restatement.

references.excerpt: Article 13 - General Provisions.

items.item_text: What are the Names Of Majority Owners, if any?
items.answer: N/A
